# HEVC capture-buffer ownership (pinned Asahi AVD)

**AI disclosure:** Generated by AI. Source-attributed; firmware-written bytes stay unknown.

Capture 448×240 8-bit 4:2:0 as published for RPS_E picture 28.

| Region | Range (Gst packed plane) | Allocator | Init | CPU map | DMA | Sync | Reuse | Firmware |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Decoded NV12 pixels | `[0, 161280)` = `v4l2_fill_pixfmt_mp` sizeimage | vb2 capture plane | decoder output | mmap/DMABUF after DQBUF | device write | no `dma_sync_*` in AVD; dma-contig/iommu | vb2 requeue | **unknown** exact pixels; RPS_E corrupt here |
| Compressed luma payload | `start+off1` .. `start+off0` → `[161280, 275968)` | same plane | firmware | same | device RW | none in AVD | with the vb2 buffer | **unknown** bytes |
| Compressed luma metadata | `start+off0` .. `start+off3` → `[275968, 280064)` | same | firmware | same | device RW | none | same | **unknown** |
| Compressed chroma payload | `start+off3` .. `start+off2` → `[280064, 337408)` | same | firmware | same | device RW | none | same | **unknown** |
| Compressed chroma metadata | `start+off2` .. `start+comp` → `[337408, 338432)` | same | firmware | same | device RW | none | same | **unknown** |
| HEVC MV (`mv_color`) | Gst: `[338432, 345600)`; VA: `[360960, 368128)` = `dst_len - mv_color_size` | same plane tail | firmware | same | device RW | none | same | **unknown** |
| Instruction segments | `ctx->job.segments` | `kvalloc` / job | CPU then DMA | kernel | device read | coherent alloc not used here | per job | consumed |
| Per-context scratch | `avd_buf` via `dma_alloc_coherent` | `avd_buf_alloc` | coherent | kernel VA | bidirectional | coherent | context lifetime | **unknown** contents |

`fill_comp` (`avd-drv.c:41-70`) is pure arithmetic from image_fmt and aligned width/height. `start_offset` is uncompressed `sizeimage` before compressed/MV append (`avd-v4l2.c:82-84`). HEVC then adds `mv_color_size` (`avd-hevc.c:980-981`). The driver programs MV at `y_out + (plane_length - mv_size)` (`avd-hevc.c:1281`), so a longer VA DMABUF places MV after a pad gap; Gst MMAP length equals packed `sizeimage`, so MV sits immediately after compressed data. That gap is an allocation-length observation, **not a proved bug**.

No AVD `dma_sync_*` calls exist in the pinned tree. Capture buffers are vb2-dma-contig. Stale compressed content on reuse is **not proved** from source; vb2 requeue of a completed buffer is the reuse path. Overlap of the four compressed regions is defined by `fill_comp` offsets and is disjoint by construction (mutation of tile size breaks the published offsets).
